newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Specials power record Bucharest bourse turnover.
newsitem.headline: Specials power record Bucharest bourse turnover.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange touched a new all-time high in turnover on Thursday with around 65 billion lei, sharply up from a previous record of 25.9 billion lei on Wednesday.
A bourse official said special deals in first-tier Azomures fertiliser maker and chemical plant Oltchim took around 75 percent of that turnover level.
"Once again there was foreign interest behind today's special trades," a broker said.
Further details about Thursday's session are due later in the afternoon, the exchange said.
Azomures and Oltchim had a total six special trades -- deals struck outside the market and reported to the exchange later -- on Wednesday, sending turnover to an all-time high.
Foreign buyers have been active in the Romanian capital market over the past few days, after the government announced new portfolio investment rules.

But brokers said the trend might reverse soon, after announced amendments to the initially proposed project, replacing a four percent capital gains repatriation tax with a 1.5 percent fee per portfolio buying deal. The new tax is generally viewed as prohibitive.
